event.heading: A Local Customer Experience—Not Just Another Discount
paragraphs: Weekend van de Klant takes place across Belgium on 3 and 4 October 2026. The annual event, organised by UNIZO, UCM and Comeos, invites merchants to thank customers with a small extra or an experience that helps people rediscover local businesses.

For Dalila, the most credible action is access to expertise: a focused conversation about a diamond brief, live natural-diamond availability or grading-report information. The official guidance does not require participating businesses to open on both days and does not recommend discounting as the central offer. That allows Dalila to publish a limited, appointment-only schedule that respects security, building access and the specialist nature of diamond sourcing.

appointments.heading: Choose the Conversation You Need
appointments.offerNote: Use "complimentary appointment" only after Dalila confirms which appointment types are free, their duration, their audience and any exclusions. Diamond purchases, laboratory services, appraisals and custom sourcing costs are separate unless explicitly stated.

items.title: Trade Diamond Brief Clinic
items.body: Bring the intended jewellery type, shape, quantity, carat or dimensions, colour, clarity, grading-report preference, budget and required receipt date. Dalila can identify missing specifications and explain the next sourcing step. Suitable for jewellers, designers, manufacturers, wholesalers and independent jewellery brands.

items.title: Grading-Report Check and Explanation
items.body: Bring the original grading report or a clear report number. Dalila can help compare the document with the issuing laboratory's online record where that service is available and explain common fields such as measurements, the 4Cs, polish, symmetry and fluorescence. This is not physical-diamond authentication, an appraisal or a valuation.

items.title: Current Natural-Diamond Stock Review
items.body: Request to review currently available loose natural diamonds that fit a defined need. Availability must be reconfirmed before the appointment; a website result does not reserve a stone. The session can cover centre stones, fancy shapes, matched pairs or calibrated natural-diamond requirements, subject to live stock.

items.title: Confirmed Trade Collection or Office Visit
items.body: Professional buyers with an approved order can ask whether secure Antwerp collection or an office appointment is feasible during the event window. Collection is never automatic and must be confirmed with identification, order status, access instructions and timing.

appointments.imageAlt: Natural diamond consultation and grading-report appointment options in Antwerp

prepare.heading: Bring the Information That Makes the Session Useful
paragraphs: For a sourcing consultation, prepare the intended piece, required quantity, shape, size or carat range, colour, clarity, report preference, budget and real deadline. Mark each requirement as essential or flexible. For matched pairs or multi-stone layouts, include measurement tolerances and a scale drawing.

For a grading-report discussion, send the laboratory name and report number in advance. Bring the original document if available. Do not bring a loose diamond, finished jewellery or another valuable item unless Dalila has specifically agreed to inspect or receive it and has provided secure access instructions.

whyDalila.heading: Natural-Diamond Sourcing from Antwerp's Diamond District
paragraphs: Dalila Diamonds is based at Hoveniersstraat 30 in Antwerp and brings more than 50 years of family diamond-industry experience to professional sourcing. The team works with jewellers, designers, manufacturers, wholesalers, luxury retailers and independent brands seeking loose natural diamonds for production, stock or client-led commissions.

An appointment can begin with a specific centre stone, matched pair, fancy shape, calibrated melee requirement or complete custom brief. Dalila presents currently available or sourced options for professional review; the jeweller remains responsible for the finished design, setting, client quotation, warranty and aftercare.

"Sourced through Antwerp" describes the trade and sourcing location. It does not mean that a natural diamond was mined in Belgium. The grading report and available documentation for each selected stone should be reviewed on their own terms.
whyDalila.tradeNote: Dalila does not sell finished jewellery or lab-grown diamonds on this page. Private visitors should ask whether they are eligible and, where appropriate, have their chosen jeweller coordinate the sourcing and later setting.

faqs.heading: Weekend van de Klant Appointments at Dalila Diamonds

items.q: When is Weekend van de Klant in 2026?
items.a: The official event takes place on Saturday 3 and Sunday 4 October 2026.

items.q: Who organises Weekend van de Klant?
items.a: UNIZO, UCM and Comeos organise the nationwide event.

items.q: Is Dalila Diamonds an official 2026 participant?
items.a: Dalila is preparing appointment availability for the 2026 event. Confirmed slots and a link to the official participant profile will appear here once registration and the directory listing are complete.

items.q: Is Dalila open on both Saturday and Sunday?
items.a: Only approved appointment slots should be displayed. The official event permits merchants to choose one or both days, so the event dates do not automatically become Dalila opening hours.

items.q: Can I visit without an appointment?
items.a: No walk-in access is available. Request an appointment and wait for written confirmation and access instructions before travelling.

The main audience is professional buyers, including jewellers, designers, manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers and jewellery brands. Private-client eligibility must be confirmed by Dalila and may require involvement from the client's jeweller.

items.q: Are Weekend van de Klant appointments free?
items.a: An appointment is complimentary only after Dalila approves the relevant appointment type, duration and eligibility. Diamond purchases and any separate professional or laboratory services remain outside that offer unless expressly included.
No. Dalila supplies loose natural diamonds. A jeweller or atelier designs, sets, sells and services the finished piece.
No. Dalila's offer is focused on natural diamonds.

items.q: What is a diamond grading-report check?
items.a: It compares report details with the issuing laboratory's online record where available and explains the information recorded on the report. It does not prove that an unexamined physical stone matches the report.

items.q: Is a grading-report check an appraisal or valuation?
items.a: No. A grading report describes assessed characteristics such as dimensions and quality factors. It does not state an appraisal value or guarantee a price.

items.q: Can Dalila authenticate my diamond during the appointment?
items.a: Physical-diamond identification or laboratory analysis requires a separately agreed scope, secure handling and appropriate expertise. This is not part of the standard appointment offer.

items.q: What natural diamonds can professional buyers discuss?
items.a: Subject to current availability and specifications, buyers can discuss centre stones, matched pairs, fancy shapes, calibrated melee and custom sourcing.

items.q: Can I reserve a diamond through the website?
items.a: Viewing a listing or requesting an appointment does not reserve a diamond. Dalila must confirm the specific stone and commercial terms.

items.q: Can I collect a confirmed order during the event weekend?
items.a: Only if Dalila approves the order, collection timing, identification and building-access arrangements in writing.
Dalila's B2B page lists English, Dutch, French, Hindi and Hebrew. Confirm which team member and language are available for the selected weekend slot.
